items.title: For an exec target with a relative `ToolchainRoot` such as `
items.body: For an exec target with a relative `ToolchainRoot` such as `.toolchain`, `goCommand` is `.toolchain/bin/go` and the new working directory is `.toolchain`. The command is then resolved under that directory, so valid exec-target preparation fails. The preimage ran the command from the caller’s working directory.
items.suggestion: Make `goCommand` absolute before deriving its working directory.

items.title: Linked capability review calls `ReadToolchainIdentity` without its caller context
items.body: Linked capability review calls `ReadToolchainIdentity` without its caller context. Cancellation during that identity query waits for the command’s watchdog. Use the private context-aware identity helper at this call site.
